active_query_observations.query: SET SESSION AUTHORIZATION DEFAULT;RESET ALL;CLOSE ALL;UNLISTEN *;SELECT pg_advisory_unlock_all();DISCARD SEQUENCES;DISCARD TEMP

SELECT a.slug, a.title, a.description, a.body, COALESCE((
    SELECT array_agg(s.name ORDER BY s.name)
    FROM (
        SELECT t.name, 1 AS "Key"
        FROM article_tags AS a0
        INNER JOIN tags AS t ON a0.tag_id = t.id
        WHERE a.id = a0.article_id
    ) AS s
    GROUP BY s."Key"
    LIMIT 1), ARRAY[]::text[]), a.created_at, a.updated_at, EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM favorites AS f
    WHERE a.id = f.article_id AND f.user_id = $1), (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM favorites AS f0
    WHERE a.id = f0.article_id), u.username, u.bio, u.image, EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM follows AS f1
    WHERE u.id = f1.followee_id AND f1.follower_id = $1)
FROM articles AS a
INNER JOIN users AS u ON a.author_id = u.id
WHERE a.slug = $2
LIMIT 2

SELECT a.slug, a.title, a.description, NULL, COALESCE((
    SELECT array_agg(s.name ORDER BY s.name)
    FROM (
        SELECT t0.name, 1 AS "Key"
        FROM article_tags AS a1
        INNER JOIN tags AS t0 ON a1.tag_id = t0.id
        WHERE a.id = a1.article_id
    ) AS s
    GROUP BY s."Key"
    LIMIT 1), ARRAY[]::text[]), a.created_at, a.updated_at, EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM favorites AS f
    WHERE a.id = f.article_id AND f.user_id = $1), (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM favorites AS f0
    WHERE a.id = f0.article_id), u.username, u.bio, u.image, EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM follows AS f1
    WHERE u.id = f1.followee_id AND f1.follower_id = $1)
FROM articles AS a
INNER JOIN users AS u ON a.author_id = u.id
WHERE a.id IN (

    WHERE a0.tag_id IN (

    LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4
)
ORDER BY a.id DESC

SELECT a0.slug, a0.title, a0.description, NULL, COALESCE((
    SELECT array_agg(s.name ORDER BY s.name)
    FROM (
        SELECT t.name, 1 AS "Key"
        FROM article_tags AS a1
        INNER JOIN tags AS t ON a1.tag_id = t.id
        WHERE a0.id = a1.article_id
    ) AS s
    GROUP BY s."Key"
    LIMIT 1), ARRAY[]::text[]), a0.created_at, a0.updated_at, EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM favorites AS f
    WHERE a0.id = f.article_id AND f.user_id = $1), (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM favorites AS f0
    WHERE a0.id = f0.article_id), u.username, u.bio, u.image, EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM follows AS f1
    WHERE u.id = f1.followee_id AND f1.follower_id = $1)
FROM (
    SELECT a.id, a.author_id, a.created_at, a.description, a.slug, a.title, a.updated_at
    FROM articles AS a
    ORDER BY a.id DESC
    LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
) AS a0
INNER JOIN users AS u ON a0.author_id = u.id
ORDER BY a0.id DESC

SELECT a0.id, s.id, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.body, s.username, s.bio, s.image, s.c, s.id0
FROM (
    SELECT a.id
    FROM articles AS a
    WHERE a.slug = $1
    LIMIT 2
) AS a0
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c0.id, c0.created_at, c0.updated_at, c0.body, u.username, u.bio, u.image, EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM follows AS f
        WHERE u.id = f.followee_id AND f.follower_id = $2) AS c, u.id AS id0
    FROM (
        SELECT c.id, c.author_id, c.body, c.created_at, c.updated_at
        FROM comments AS c
        WHERE c.article_id = a0.id
        ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
        LIMIT 100
    ) AS c0
    INNER JOIN users AS u ON c0.author_id = u.id
) AS s ON TRUE
ORDER BY a0.id, s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC

SELECT a1.slug, a1.title, a1.description, NULL, COALESCE((
    SELECT array_agg(s0.name ORDER BY s0.name)
    FROM (
        SELECT t.name, 1 AS "Key"
        FROM article_tags AS a2
        INNER JOIN tags AS t ON a2.tag_id = t.id
        WHERE a1.id = a2.article_id
    ) AS s0
    GROUP BY s0."Key"
    LIMIT 1), ARRAY[]::text[]), a1.created_at, a1.updated_at, EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM favorites AS f0
    WHERE a1.id = f0.article_id AND f0.user_id = s."FollowerId"), (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM favorites AS f1
    WHERE a1.id = f1.article_id), u.username, u.bio, u.image, TRUE
FROM (
    SELECT a0."Id", a0."FollowerId"
    FROM follows AS f
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT a.id AS "Id", f.follower_id AS "FollowerId"
        FROM articles AS a
        WHERE a.author_id = f.followee_id
        ORDER BY a.id DESC
        LIMIT $1
    ) AS a0 ON TRUE
    WHERE f.follower_id = $2
    ORDER BY a0."Id" DESC
    LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4
) AS s
INNER JOIN articles AS a1 ON s."Id" = a1.id
INNER JOIN users AS u

INSERT INTO comments (article_id, author_id, body, created_at, updated_at)

RETURNING id
